Title: Recent DMA Data Portability API Changes

Blocks.Text: No partner-visible API changes were introduced in this version.

Publishing Original Article API
The coverMediaV2 field supports both video and image cover media in the Original Articles API.

Lead Analytics API
The Lead Analytics API no longer supports versions 202508 and earlier. Update the LinkedIn-Version header in your requests to 202604.
The following APIs and their related fields are deprecated:

Employee Broadcast Audience Time Series Analytics
Employee Broadcast Highlights
Employee Broadcast Analytics
Employee Broadcast Audience Demographic Analytics
Organization Search Appearance

Pages Events
The premiumGated field in the Event Settings Schema table indicates whether the event is gated behind a premium subscription.
Admin Content API - Get Assets By Organization
Admin Partners can fetch digital media assets owned by their organizations. These media assets contain media information such as images and videos.

The My Company tab and related features on LinkedIn Pages are being removed beginning in November 2024 (details). Accordingly, the LinkedIn Pages My Company tab, the Employee Advocacy tab, and the curator administrator role will be phased out and completely unavailable by January 2025. All page administrators currently assigned to Curator roles will be converted to Analyst roles starting January 2025.
The following endpoints and other specified fields will be discontinued beginning with the February 2025 release version:

To retain your Employee Broadcast Analytics data and other specified fields, export your analytics before January 2025, as such data can no longer be available for export beginning with the February 2025 release.
Organizational Page Visitor Of The Day API
Partners can fetch Visitor Of The Day data for an Organizational Page to keep track of their Organization's audience. For more information, refer to Organizational Page Visitor Of The Day API.

Content Ingestion Sources API: Find by Page
Partners can fetch content ingestion sources that one of their managed pages owns. These content ingestion sources reference RSS feeds that will be ingested and posted on the page’s feed. OrganizationalPage Content Ingestion Sources API.

Organizational Page Credibility API
Partners can fetch Page Credibility, a premium page feature that enables pages to showcase any recognition or awards that they received. For more information, refer to Organizational Page Credibility API.
